attchmntText: Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited
voiceSummary: Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited announced the Board of Directors meeting outcome on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Chairman and Managing Director Venkat Manohar Dontamsetti was authorized to sign the results. The company reported a net loss of 36.03 lakh INR for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Total revenue for the half year was 615.25 lakh INR. Total assets stood at 7387.46 lakh INR as of September 30, 2026. The financial statements were reviewed by P. Suryanarayana & Co., Chartered Accountants. The results will be published in newspapers and on the company website.
